chapter.heading: Ezekiel 42
The Temple’s Chambers
chapter.v: 42 Then he led me out intothe outer court, toward the north, and he brought me to the chambers that were opposite the separate yard and opposite the building on the north.
the breadth fifty cubits.
gallery against gallery in three stories.
their doors were on the north.
Now the upper chambers were narrower, for the galleries took more away from them than from the lower and middle chambers of the building.
For they were in three stories, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the courts. Thus the upper chambers were set back from the ground more than the lower and the middle ones.
fifty cubits long.
a hundred cubits long.
an entrance on the east side, as one enters them from the outer court.
chambers
doors,
the corresponding wall on the east as one enters them.
the guilt offering—for the place is holy.
They shall put on other garments before they go near to that which is for the people.”
the gate that faced east, and measured the temple area all around.
the measuring reed, 500 cubits by the measuring reed all around.
He measured the north side, 500 cubits by the measuring reed all around.
He measured the south side, 500 cubits by the measuring reed.

to make a separation between the holy and the common.
